# Story 01 — Agent can view customer profile with contact details (Story: SCRUM-5)

## Prerequisites

- Prisma **`Customer`** model already exists (`backend/prisma/schema.prisma:94`) as introduced by migration `backend/prisma/migrations/20260910120000_add_customer_and_password_reset/migration.sql`. No new migration is required for this story.
- Staff shell and navigation already provision a `customers` entry (`frontend/pages/staff/customers/index.vue`, currently a placeholder). This story turns the placeholder area into a functional profile view.
- Follow the module conventions used by the existing users module (`backend/src/modules/users/*`) — controller + service + DTOs + Nest module, guards from `backend/src/modules/auth/guards/`, roles decorator from `backend/src/modules/auth/decorators/roles.decorator.ts`.
- Ticket module is **not** in the repo yet; the "Accessible from ticket view" AC is fulfilled by ensuring the profile is reachable by stable route (`/staff/customers/:id`) that a future ticket view can link to. Do **not** stub a ticket page.

---

## Story Goal

Give a staff/support agent a read-only customer profile page that surfaces the customer's **name**, **contact details** (email, phone), and **account info** (id, created/updated timestamps, active status, any account-level flags on the `Customer` model). The profile must be:

1. Fetchable via a stable REST endpoint `GET /customers/:id` guarded by JWT + role guard (agent/admin).
2. Rendered on a stable Nuxt route `/staff/customers/:id` behind the existing `auth` middleware and staff layout.
3. Linked from the customers list page (`frontend/pages/staff/customers/index.vue`) so agents can navigate to a customer without a ticket context yet.

**Not in scope:** editing customer data, listing/searching customers with filters beyond a minimal list, ticket history, password reset from this page, RBAC changes.

## Product rules (from story)

**Acceptance criteria:**

- **AC1:** Profile shows name, contact details (email, phone), and account info (id, active/inactive, createdAt, updatedAt, any account-level identifiers stored on `Customer`).
- **AC2:** Accessible from the ticket view. Since a ticket view does not yet exist, we satisfy this by providing a stable deep-link route (`/staff/customers/:id`) and linking to it from the customers list. Document the link contract in the plan so the ticket story can pick it up.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Unknown id / non-uuid id.** Backend returns `404` with code `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`; frontend page shows `customers.notFound`. Enforced in `customers.service.ts` (`getById`) and rendered in `pages/staff/customers/[id].vue`.
- **Deactivated customer.** Profile still renders but shows the inactive chip. `Customer.active` (or equivalent) is included in the DTO; verify the column name on `schema.prisma:94–113`.
- **Missing optional fields.** Phone may be nullable in Prisma; UI renders an em-dash. DTO must type `phone: string | null`.
- **PII leakage.** Do not include password hashes, reset tokens, or internal-only flags in `CustomerProfileDto`. Enforced by explicit mapping in the service, not by `select *`.
- **RBAC.** Portal users must not reach `/customers/:id`. Enforced by `RolesGuard` with agent/admin roles.
- **Unicode names, RTL.** Existing RTL plumbing (`frontend/plugins/rtl.client.ts`) covers rendering; ensure profile card containers do not hard-code `text-align: left`.
- **Concurrent updates elsewhere.** This is a read-only view; no optimistic locking needed. Refresh on route change to pick up updates.
- **Audit spam.** A single `CUSTOMER_VIEWED` per request is fine; ensure the interceptor does not double-log on redirects or 4xx responses — verify against `backend/src/common/interceptors/audit-log.interceptor.spec.ts` behaviour.
